name: Lusail International Circuit
layout: Grand Prix circuit (F1 and WEC Qatar 1812 km)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap raceway ways 1553605580 + 152483595, (c) OSM contributors; start/finish gantry located on Esri World Imagery
sources.width: published: ~12 m typical (MotoGP-spec circuit), start/finish straight ~16 m (section mapping, not measured)
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/), rolling 25th percentile (+-45 m) then robust-median smoothed; desert site, nearly flat
sources.camber: none (30 m DEM cannot resolve crossfall)
sources.pit: OSM ways 1037707300 ("F1 Pit entry", cuts inside Turn 16) + 196193732 ("Pit Lane")
sources.trim: high downforce: flowing medium/high-speed corners, only one long straight
sources.pitLimit: FIA F1 Sporting Regulations 80 km/h; FIA WEC pit-lane limit 60 km/h
sources.pitLoss: approximate F1 public strategy previews (~25-27 s, long pit lane with F1-specific entry)

notes: Turn numbers follow the 16-turn circuit map (assignment of T4-T11 apexes from curvature peaks; T4 is the long right). No F1 sprint in 2026 (Qatar hosted sprints 2023-2025).
